items: 【Durable and Long-lasting Outdoor Furniture】Experience the durability and reliability of this 4 piece outdoor furniture. Crafted with premium PE rattan and a sturdy powder-coated steel frame, it is built to withstand any weather condition, ensuring years of outdoor enjoyment. Whether you have a balcony, lawn, garden, or poolside, this set is perfect for all outdoor spaces.

【Comfortable Seating and Modern Design】Enjoy ultimate comfort with the 3-inch seat back cushions and ergonomic backrest of this patio furniture set. Designed to provide optimal support for you and your family, it allows for extended hours of relaxation outdoors.

【Easy to Maintain Patio Furniture】Cleaning and maintaining this patio furniture is a breeze. The cushion covers can be easily removed with the zipper design, allowing for convenient cleaning. The splash-proof material ensures hassle-free maintenance. Additionally, the tempered glass top of the coffee table can be cleaned by simply soaking a towel in fresh water. For tough stains, soak the towel in water at 100°F for effective cleaning.

【Versatile Sectional Conversation Set】This patio furniture offers flexibility in configuration, allowing you to arrange the sofas according to your space requirements. Whether you have a small or large area, this set can adapt to fit different room sizes, giving you the freedom to create your desired outdoor seating arrangement.

【Complete Set for Outdoor Enjoyment】The outdoor patio furniture set includes 1 x loveseat measuring 48" x 26" x 30.3", 2 x armchairs measuring 28.4" x 26.4" x 30.3", and 1 x coffee table measuring 34.3" x 19.7" x 13.8",which come in 2 boxes. They may not arrive together. If you encounter any issues, such as missing parts or damage, please contact us for support. With this complete set, you can make the most of the warm weather and enjoy outdoor living to the fullest.
